evals.prompt: Evaluate, sanitize, and adapt the upstream skill provided in the input directory. Ensure it aligns with our local GITHUB_WORKFLOW.md standards.
evals.expected_output: A sanitized and adapted skill that incorporates the GITHUB_WORKFLOW.md requirements and is free of emojis or em dashes.
assertions: The SKILL.md file is under 500 lines in length.
The files do not contain any unicode em dashes.
